--- stderr
Usage of gomad analyze:
  -build-tag value
    	validated Go build tag
  -capability-mode string
    	closure, linked, or guarded capability assessment (default "closure")
  -format string
    	text or json (default "text")
  -timeout duration
    	analysis wall-time bound
  -toolchain-root string
    	absolute pinned toolchain root
  -working-dir string
    	absolute target module root (default: the current directory)
